dataset: N-MNIST, Mendeley Data v1, official Test.zip
sample: Within each digit sort .bin paths by sha256('NN-NMNIST-20261119-v1|' plus full archive path). Select the first 32. For digit d and j=0..15 pair its j-th recording with recording 16+j of digit (d+1) modulo 10. Each recording used once.
descriptor: One bit for each of four fixed y bands indexed by floor(4*y/34); bit=1 iff more events have x>=17 than x<17 in the band. Both polarities and all saccades retained, ties or empty band map to zero. Skip overflow markers (y=240).
network: 4 modules, directed unit-weight ring, original integer model; no control access to state bits
write: 14 for 2 ticks followed by 6 for settling with zero drive
measure: same old and new event descriptors per arm. Primary endpoint all four rewritten bits correct. Also exact zero after release, old read correctness, old whole-word intrusion among changed words, bit errors, native protocol E,D,H; global zero required even when old code denotes zero bits.
readout: two-step spike counts, unique winner per bit. Score entire 4-bit word.
inference: 160 paired episodes, no repeated sample, deterministic pilot. Interval if requested descriptive Wilson per arm. No image or event classification claim, and no claim about a naturally measured topology.
